title: Recruiting with AI: Does the Degree Still Matter?
affiliations: Fudan University - School of Management, Fudan University - School of Management and Fudan University - School of Management

detail.title: Recruiting with AI: Does the Degree Still Matter?
detail.abstract: Recruiting has become one of the most prominent domains for large-scale deployment of artificial intelligence (AI), with firms increasingly relying on automated systems to filter and prioritize applicants before human review. Yet despite rapid adoption, two foundational design questions remain unresolved: Where in the hiring pipeline should AI be positioned, and does the classic role of education-based degree gating remain useful once AI can evaluate every candidate? This research note develops a gametheoretical model in which AI is a noisy but scalable assessor, human interviews are perfectly accurate but costly, and educational degrees function as exogenous signals more common among high-ability candidates. The firm chooses whether to gate on degrees, whether to apply AI universally or only within that gate, and whether to retain human confirmation. Three insights emerge. First, degree gates do not become obsolete: even when AI becomes inexpensive, they remain valuable efficiency enhancers whenever governance costs are manageable. Second, when the loss from mistaken hiring is non-negligible, firms optimally maintain a thin layer of human confirmation even with cheap AI, whereas at moderate AI costs they may strategically drop human oversight to balance automation cost against hiring risk. Third, as AI matures, the economic role of degrees evolves non-monotonically: when AI is costly or error-prone, degrees serve as risk-control devices that mitigate automation-induced errors; when AI becomes cheap and accurate, degrees again enhance precision and efficiency. Together, these findings offer a configuration roadmap for integrating AI, degree gating, and human oversight as hiring technologies continue to advance.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过博弈论模型分析AI在招聘中的最佳配置，发现学位门槛在AI时代仍有价值，人类确认层在AI成本适中时可能被战略性地放弃，而学位的经济价值随AI成熟度呈非线性变化。
AI.research_question: 在招聘流程中，AI应该部署在什么位置？当AI能够评估所有候选人时，基于学位的筛选机制是否仍有价值？
AI.motivation: 尽管AI在招聘中大规模应用，但关于AI在招聘流程中的最佳位置以及传统学位筛选机制在AI时代的价值等基础设计问题仍未解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型，将AI建模为有噪声但可扩展的评估者，人类面试为完全准确但成本高昂，教育学位作为高能力候选人更常见的外生信号。
AI.method: 开发理论模型，分析企业在学位筛选、AI应用范围（普遍应用或仅在学位门槛内）以及人类确认保留等方面的最优选择。
AI.findings: 1. 学位门槛不会过时，即使AI成本低廉，在治理成本可控时仍能提升效率；2. 当错误招聘损失显著时，企业应保留人类确认层；3. 学位的经济价值随AI成熟度呈非线性变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI时代招聘系统的设计提供了理论框架，揭示了学位筛选、AI部署和人类监督之间的复杂互动关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业整合AI、学位筛选和人类监督提供了配置路线图，指导企业在不同AI成熟度阶段优化招聘流程。

title: Response from MediQuills on the EU Delegated Regulation Concerning the Scheduling of Synthetic Cathinone and Amphetamine Precursors
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Response from MediQuills on the EU Delegated Regulation Concerning the Scheduling of Synthetic Cathinone and Amphetamine Precursors
detail.abstract: The European Commission’s draft Delegated Regulation addressing the control of nine synthetic cathinone and amphetamine precursors arrives at a moment when illicit stimulant production in Europe continues to shift toward simple, adaptable and unregulated chemical pathways. The substances identified in the proposal have been repeatedly seized in large quantities within the Union, which indicates their growing importance in clandestine drug synthesis. Their chemical profiles make them especially attractive to illicit producers because they require minimal processing, little specialized equipment and only basic laboratory knowledge. MediQuills recognizes that this pattern presents a real and immediate challenge for public health and enforcement authorities and supports the Commission’s intention to strengthen oversight.Several of the substances included in the draft regulation also play established and legitimate roles in pharmaceutical manufacturing, laboratory testing and scientific research. They serve as intermediates in the synthesis of common therapeutic compounds and as reference standards used to ensure the accuracy of toxicological and forensic analyses. Their legitimate uses are deeply embedded in both public health systems and research environments across the Union. The expansion of regulatory controls to Category 1, while justified from a diversion-prevention standpoint, may unintentionally strain scientific activity, delay pharmaceutical production and impose administrative pressures on institutions that are already operating with limited resources.MediQuills encourages a regulatory approach that recognizes the dual nature of these substances. Effective policy must reduce diversion risks while supporting the scientific and public-health infrastructure that relies on them. The Union’s ability to monitor emerging drug threats, maintain reliable diagnostic capacity and ensure steady access to approved medicines depends on preserving access to controlled intermediates under reasonable and predictable conditions.

title: The Virtual Space as an Environment of Reflexive Governance: The Quality of Public Opinion and Its Global Implications
affiliations: , The London Academy of Science and Business and Institute for Sustainable Development and International Relations, WSB University

detail.title: The Virtual Space as an Environment of Reflexive Governance: The Quality of Public Opinion and Its Global Implications

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any external funding.

detail.abstract: The paper explores virtual space as a dynamic environment of reflexive governance, emphasising its role in shaping public opinion and influencing global socio-political processes. Digitalisation has transformed virtual environments into autonomous realities of meaning, where human cognition, emotion, and algorithmic mediation converge. Within this hybrid domain, reflection transcends its classical cognitive interpretation and becomes a distributed communicative mechanism linking individuals, systems, and informational flows. Reflexive governance, in this sense, represents a form of anticipatory control based on modelling user reactions and algorithmic feedback loops. Drawing on philosophical, psychological, and cybernetic frameworks, the study conceptualises reflection in virtual environments as a qualitative phenomenon characterised by awareness, adequacy, and contextuality. It highlights how algorithmic personalisation and simulated feedback increasingly shape collective consciousness, blurring the boundary between authentic and artificial reflection. The paper argues that the degradation of reflective quality—through reactive and imitative behaviours—undermines trust, autonomy, and democratic resilience. Conversely, developing reflexive sovereignty, understood as the capacity to maintain control over one’s cognitive and informational processes, is proposed as a foundation for sustainable digital governance. The study concludes that the quality of reflection constitutes a critical determinant of global development, requiring interdisciplinary approaches that integrate cognitive science, digital ethics, and systems theory to strengthen awareness and agency in algorithmically mediated societies.

title: Smart Farming, IoT-based Sustainable Agriculture, and System Design using UML Diagrams

detail.title: Smart Farming, IoT-based Sustainable Agriculture, and System Design using UML Diagrams
detail.abstract: Smart farming represents an advanced agricultural approach that integrates information and communication technologies, including machinery, sensors, and intelligent devices, within network-based farm management systems. Emerging technologies such as the Internet of Things (IoT), cloud computing, robotics, and artificial intelligence are transforming traditional farming practices and introducing new opportunities, while also presenting significant operational and implementation challenges. This paper examines the application of wireless sensor technologies in IoT-enabled agriculture and explores the difficulties associated with integrating modern digital solutions into conventional farming environments. It highlights how real-time data, automated monitoring, and precision farming techniques support farmers throughout the entire crop cycle-from sowing to harvesting-and extend benefits to post-harvest processes such as packaging and transportation. In addition, the research evaluates farmers' awareness and perceptions of e-Agriculture and technology-driven marketing platforms. A statistical survey methodology was used to analyze farmers' familiarity with e-commerce tools, revealing a low level of awareness and adoption. The findings indicate a critical need for digital agricultural platforms to enhance decision-making, improve accessibility to government schemes, and enable direct market participation. The study emphasizes the creation of an online integrated system designed to empower farmers through knowledge sharing, transparent transactions, and improved market linkages, thereby supporting sustainable agricultural growth

title: Beyond Pretty Pictures: Combined Single- and Multi-Image Super-Resolution for Sentinel-2 Images
affiliations: Asian Development Bank, Asian Development Bank, Asian Development Bank, , ,  and Asian Development Bank

detail.title: Beyond Pretty Pictures: Combined Single- and Multi-Image Super-Resolution for Sentinel-2 Images

publicationDetails.detailsText: ADB Economics Working Paper Series No. 823

detail.abstract: Super-resolution (SR) aims to increase the resolution of satellite images by reconstructing high-frequency details, which go beyond naive upsampling. This has particular relevance for Earth observation missions like Sentinel-2, which offer frequent, regular coverage at no cost, but at coarse resolution. The pixel footprint of Sentinel-2 coverage is too large to capture small features like houses, streets, or hedge rows. To address this, we present SEN4X, a hybrid super-resolution architecture that combines the advantages of single image and multi-image techniques. It combines temporal oversampling from repeated Sentinel-2 acquisitions with a learned prior from high-resolution Pléiades Neo data. In doing so, SEN4X upgrades Sentinel-2 imagery to 2.5 m ground sampling distance. We test the super-resolved images on urban land-cover classification in Ha Noi, Viet Nam. We find that they lead to significant performance improvement over state-of-the-art super resolution baselines.

AI.tldr: SEN4X是一种混合超分辨率架构，结合单图像和多图像技术优势，将Sentinel-2卫星图像分辨率提升至2.5米地面采样距离，在越南河内的城市土地覆盖分类中显著优于现有超分辨率方法。
AI.research_question: 如何有效提升Sentinel-2卫星图像的分辨率以捕捉小尺度特征？
AI.motivation: Sentinel-2卫星提供免费、频繁的覆盖，但分辨率太粗糙无法捕捉房屋、街道等小特征，限制了其在精细观测中的应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合单图像超分辨率和多图像超分辨率的混合架构理论，利用时间过采样和学习先验知识。

detail.abstract: The Ukrainian War has dealt a severe blow to the global order, which has yet to recover from the shock of the COVID-19 pandemic, and the resulting changes are becoming irreversible. Changes that were already underway before the war are accelerating in an amplified form during the conflict. The Ukrainian War marks the end of the 30-year post-Cold War, post- globalization era . Over the next 3 to 5 years, the results of the restructuring of the global order will reveal its true nature. It is predicted that rather than a recovery of the old order or the emergence and solidification of a new order, it will be difficult to establish a single global order, and various orders will coexist, inevitably leading to ongoing power struggles. In other words, the global order will essentially evolve into a world of multiple orders. (The rest omitted.)

title: Pro-Debtor Bias, Court Shopping, and Bankruptcy Outcomes
affiliations: Ghent University, SKEMA Business School, SKEMA Business School - Lille Campus and Ghent University

detail.title: Pro-Debtor Bias, Court Shopping, and Bankruptcy Outcomes
detail.abstract: We develop a new measure of pro-debtor bias in Chapter 11 judicial decisions based on the content of case-level judicial orders and use it to study the consequences of strategic venue choice. Our empirical strategy exploits persistent differences in DIP attorneys' historical propensities to employ bootstrap shopping, which we use as an instrumental variable for venue selection. This preference-based design isolates variation in venue selection that reflects attorneys' long-run procedural tendencies. We find that courts issue significantly more debtor-favorable rulings when cases are brought by bootstrap shoppers, defined as firms that file in a district that is neither their principal place of business or principal assets nor their district of incorporation. Districts with stronger reputations for debtorfavorable rulings attract a larger share of these filings. Finally, higher pro-debtor bias is associated with substantially higher refiling rates, indicating a deterioration in long-run restructuring outcomes and highlighting its importance for the effectiveness of Chapter 11.

title: Chapter: Delegation and Lobbying
affiliations: Columbia University - School of International and Public Affairs and Columbia University - School of International & Public Affairs

detail.title: Chapter: Delegation and Lobbying
detail.abstract: This chapter examines the link between delegation and lobbying, two themes central to political economy. Delegation models explore how legislatures manage uncertainty and control bureaucratic agents, while lobbying models analyze how organized interests influence policy through contributions, information, and advocacy. We review the growing body of research that integrates these literatures, showing how the prospect of lobbying affects legislative incentives to delegate and how the structure of delegated authority shapes lobbying strategies. We highlight common-agency frameworks that capture the recursive relationship between delegation and lobbying and empirical studies documenting how venue choice, information provision, and interest group mobilization mediate delegation outcomes. We also review applications to agency oversight and fiscal policy. Finally, we present a model of regulatory rule-making that embeds lobbying directly into the delegation decision, offering predictions for both theory and empirical analysis.

detail.abstract: We show that the CAPM risk premium equation holds under weak assumptions in consumption-based asset pricing models, giving a testable restriction on the predictions of these models. title: Understanding ESG Disclosures: Financial Motives, Performance, and Greenwashing
affiliations: , The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - CUHK Business School and Lancaster University - Lancaster University Management School

detail.title: Understanding ESG Disclosures: Financial Motives, Performance, and Greenwashing
detail.abstract: We examine the substance and consequences of ESG disclosures in mutual fund shareholder letters from 2006 to 2024. Using FINBERT-ESG to identify ESG content and a combination of event-study and LP-DID estimator, we find that ESG disclosures generate significant positive fund flows, driven primarily by opportunistic (value-based) rather than impact (values-based) disclosure. Opportunistic disclosures predict higher fund alphas before the Paris Agreement, consistent with an informational advantage, and funds generally "walk their talk" when disclosure type is considered. However, funds face subsequent outflows when postdisclosure performance disappoints, explaining why some managers refrain from ESG disclosure despite its flow benefits.

detail.abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of Puma SE's operations and supply chain management, highlighting how the company balances global expansion with sustainability and ethical practices. Through the lens of Production and Operations Management (P&OM;), the study explores Puma's lean enterprise model, emphasizing outsourced manufacturing, centralized procurement, and digitally integrated logistics systems. The analysis also assesses the role of leadership transitions in shaping strategic execution, the implications of supplier concentration in Asia, and the integration of sustainability initiatives such as the RE:FIBRE program. The findings illustrate that Puma's operational excellence stems not from asset ownership, but from strategic orchestration-leveraging technology, long-term partnerships, and a commitment to ethical production. The paper concludes that Puma's model represents a viable blueprint for modern corporations seeking to align profitability with responsibility in a globalized economy.

title: Why the Flow of Funds Don't Explain the Flow of Funds: Sectoral Balances, Balance Sheets, and the Accumulation Fallacy May, 2022

detail.title: Why the Flow of Funds Don't Explain the Flow of Funds: Sectoral Balances, Balance Sheets, and the Accumulation Fallacy May, 2022
detail.abstract: This paper highlights and unpacks a reality that's not widely known or considered among economists: in the Financial Accounts of the United States (The Fed's quarterly Z.1 report), the Flows matrix on page 1 does not explain the changes in the Levels matrix on page 3. The same is true of the sectoral Flow and Levels tables underlying those matrixes. Nor do those tables provide balance-sheet-complete accounting of household or national wealth accumulation. Measures of net saving/investment/capital formation, and national wealth accumulation, diverge by tens of trillions of dollars. The discrepancy is explained and resolved by assembling a balance-sheet-complete empirical derivation of comprehensive U.S. household "Haig-Simons" income (long referred to as the “preferred” income measure among economists and national accountants), based on the Integrated Macroeconomic Accounts (S tables in the Z.1). The comprehensive measure is 23% higher than national accounts’ “primary” household income. Relationships to the Piketty/Saez/Zucman Distributional National Accounts (DINAs) are discussed, along with implications for economic theory and empirical modeling, both mainstream and heterodox/Post-Keynesian.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示美联储Z.1报告中流量矩阵无法解释存量矩阵变化的问题，通过构建完整的资产负债表方法推导出全面的美国家庭Haig-Simons收入，该收入比国民账户中的主要家庭收入高出23%。

AI.findings: 全面的Haig-Simons收入衡量比国民账户中的"主要"家庭收入高出23%；净储蓄/投资/资本形成与国家财富积累的衡量存在数万亿美元差异。

title: Implementing Systematic Risk Premia, Factor-Based Strategies, and Sector Rotation with ETFs
affiliations: Aisot Technologies AG, New York University (NYU) - Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences and University of Zurich

detail.title: Implementing Systematic Risk Premia, Factor-Based Strategies, and Sector Rotation with ETFs
detail.abstract: This article introduces a simple and practical methodology for implementing systematic investment strategies using exchange-traded funds (ETFs) tailored to long-only investors, such as family offices and wealth managers. The proposed approach enables portfolio managers to efficiently express views on risk premia, style factors, and sector trends by tilting portfolios toward selected exposures-while controlling risk relative to a chosen benchmark. The methodology does not require explicit return forecasts and can be flexibly adapted to a range of investment objectives and constraints. We illustrate the approach through three case studies in equities and fixed income, demonstrating how managers can implement dynamic factor tilts and sector rotation using ETFs in a transparent, low-cost, and scalable manner.

title: What's the Value of Music, and Who Should Decide its Worth?
affiliations: Stockholm School of Economics

detail.title: What's the Value of Music, and Who Should Decide its Worth?
detail.abstract: In the streaming era, music revenues have become increasingly measurable, which has led to a surge in music rights investments. Yet the question of how to assess the value of music as an investable asset remains largely unresolved. This paper explores how to value something as priceless as music, outlining the shift from costly expert valuation of music rights to auction and participatory market models. Using Tangy Market as a case study, it examines how datadriven machine learning founded valuation and real-time trading can improve price transparency and lower transaction costs. The findings suggest that open, participatory markets may enhance price discovery and help define a fair market value for music.

This paper presents the foundational quantitative proof for the Clarity Tax™, the largest unquantified, multi-billion dollar liability on a modern balance sheet. The Tax is the direct financial consequence of the Strategic Void™ [1], a systemic market failure in the high-stakes advisory market. title: Comparative Analysis of Underwriting Practices: Lehman Brothers vs. J.P. Morgan Chase

detail.title: Comparative Analysis of Underwriting Practices: Lehman Brothers vs. J.P. Morgan Chase

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, animals, or proprietary datasets requiring ethical approval.

detail.abstract: The 2008 Global Financial Crisis revealed deep vulnerabilities in the risk management and underwriting practices of major financial institutions. This paper presents a comparative analysis of Lehman Brothers and J.P. Morgan Chase to explore how differences in underwriting standards, leverage management, and liquidity strategy led to divergent outcomes during the crisis. Lehman Brothers' aggressive pursuit of profit through subprime mortgage-backed securities, weak credit assessments, and excessive leverage (approximately 30:1) resulted in catastrophic exposure when housing prices collapsed. In contrast, J.P. Morgan Chase, under the leadership of Jamie Dimon, maintained conservative underwriting standards, limited subprime exposure, and prioritized liquidity through its "fortress balance sheet" approach. The analysis concludes that prudent underwriting and disciplined risk governance are essential for institutional resilience. The contrasting fates of these firms underscore that underwriting quality and leverage control are not peripheral considerations but the foundation of sustainable financial stability.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比雷曼兄弟和摩根大通在2008年金融危机中的表现，分析了两家机构在承销标准、杠杆管理和流动性策略方面的差异如何导致截然不同的结果。雷曼因激进的次贷证券投资、薄弱的信用评估和过高杠杆而崩溃，而摩根大通则通过保守承销、限制次贷敞口和流动性优先策略保持了稳定。
AI.research_question: 雷曼兄弟和摩根大通在承销标准、杠杆管理和流动性策略方面的差异如何导致它们在2008年金融危机中截然不同的命运？
AI.motivation: 2008年全球金融危机揭示了主要金融机构在风险管理和承销实践中的深层次脆弱性，需要深入分析导致不同机构命运差异的关键因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于风险管理理论、承销标准理论和杠杆管理理论，分析金融机构在危机中的韧性差异。
AI.method: 比较分析法，通过对雷曼兄弟和摩根大通的案例对比研究。
AI.findings: 雷曼兄弟因激进的次贷抵押贷款支持证券投资、薄弱的信用评估和过高杠杆（约30:1）而在房价崩盘时遭受灾难性损失；摩根大通则通过保守承销标准、限制次贷敞口和"堡垒资产负债表"方法保持稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对金融机构风险管理中承销质量和杠杆控制核心作用的理论认识，强调了这些因素对机构韧性的决定性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了具体的风险管理实践指导，强调了保守承销标准、审慎杠杆管理和流动性优先策略在危机防范中的重要性。

title: Portfolio Value-at-Risk and Expected Shortfall: Models, Multi-Day Scaling, and Statistical Assessment

detail.title: Portfolio Value-at-Risk and Expected Shortfall: Models, Multi-Day Scaling, and Statistical Assessment
detail.abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive examination of portfolio Value-at-Risk (VaR) and Expected Shortfall (ES) across a broad range of modelling frameworks, with a particular focus on the validity of the square-root-of-time rule for extending one-day risk forecasts to the ten-day horizon required by regulatory capital standards. We review and implement variance-covariance methods, moving-average and EWMA volatility estimators, GARCH-based specifications, Historical and Filtered Historical Simulation, nonlinear delta-gamma-vega-rho-theta approximations, Monte Carlo portfolio revaluation, Extreme Value Theory for tails, and copula-based dependence models. For each engine, we derive the mathematical form of VaR and ES, examine their multi-day aggregation properties, and assess whether the assumptions underlying naive scaling are theoretically defensible. To evaluate scaling in practice, we develop a unified statistical framework that combines coverage-based tests, dynamic quantile regression, loss-based Diebold-Mariano comparisons, and distributional diagnostics based on quantile and variance ratios. Beyond standard approaches, we introduce three methodological extensions: empirical scaling exponents for VaR and ES, a joint loss function for comparing paired VaR-ES forecasts, and a composite index summarizing miscalibration across all diagnostic dimensions. These tools provide a rigorous and operationally tractable method for determining when scaled one-day forecasts accurately approximate direct ten-day risk measures and when horizon-specific modelling is essential. The results demonstrate that deviations from Gaussian iid assumptions-including volatility clustering, serial dependence, nonlinear exposures, and heavy-tailed returns-substantially weaken the reliability of square-root extrapolation. The framework developed here offers both researchers and practitioners a transparent and robust basis for assessing multi-day risk, guiding the choice of modeling approaches, and supporting risk-governance and regulatory decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了投资组合VaR和ES在不同建模框架下的表现，特别关注平方根时间法则在将单日风险预测扩展到监管要求的十日水平时的有效性。研究发现，当偏离高斯iid假设时，平方根外推法的可靠性显著降低。
AI.research_question: 平方根时间法则在将单日VaR和ES预测扩展到十日水平时的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 监管资本标准要求十日风险预测，但实践中常使用平方根时间法则从单日预测进行外推，需要验证这种方法的理论合理性和实际准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: VaR和ES理论、平方根时间法则、极值理论、copula依赖模型、GARCH波动率建模
AI.method: 综合评估多种建模方法：方差-协方差法、移动平均和EWMA波动率估计器、GARCH模型、历史模拟、蒙特卡洛投资组合重估等；开发统一统计框架进行实证检验
AI.findings: 当存在波动率聚类、序列依赖、非线性敞口和厚尾收益等偏离高斯iid假设的情况时，平方根外推法的可靠性显著降低
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了三种方法扩展：VaR和ES的经验缩放指数、配对VaR-ES预测的联合损失函数、跨所有诊断维度的综合校准指数
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员和从业者提供了透明稳健的框架，用于评估多日风险、指导建模方法选择、支持风险治理和监管决策

detail.abstract: Climate change is inducing irregular migration in Sub-Saharan Africa. Science, technology, and multi-stakeholder innovation collaboratives have been essential in resilience-building and adaptation to climate challenges in the region. These resilience-building activities are becoming progressively STEM-reliant and systematic, creating replicable procedures, or algorithms, that enhance food and water security while reducing climate disaster risks. Using an integrated resilience-building framework that prioritizes understanding vulnerabilities and structural needs in response to climate challenges, this paper examines how climate-smart agriculture, enhanced data gathering and measurement capabilities, and multi-stakeholder innovation collaboratives are mitigating climate risks that repeatedly cause the displacement and migration of thousands of people in Sub-Saharan Africa. The experience of Sub-Saharan Africa in responding to climate migration might provide useful insights about climate resilience that are applicable to other global regions experiencing similar climate-induced challenges.

title: Medicaid Coverage of GLP-1 Receptor Agonists for Obesity: A Comprehensive Framework for Evidence-Based Policy Reform

detail.title: Medicaid Coverage of GLP-1 Receptor Agonists for Obesity: A Comprehensive Framework for Evidence-Based Policy Reform
detail.abstract: The persistent issue of obesity-related health disparities among Medicaid beneficiaries represents a fundamental failure of equal access to effective medical treatment. This paper proposes a comprehensive framework for Medicaid coverage of GLP-1 receptor agonists (semaglutide, tirzepatide) for obesity treatment, grounded in clinical evidence, economic analysis, and implementation strategies. We demonstrate that coverage of these medications constitutes both sound fiscal policy and a moral imperative. Clinical trials involving over 50,000 participants demonstrate 15-21% weight loss with GLP-1 therapy-comparable to bariatric surgery outcomes-along with 20% reduction in major cardiovascular events (SELECT trial, HR 0.80, p<0.001) and 69% reduction in progression from prediabetes to diabetes. Economic modeling reveals that while coverage costs $31 billion annually at steady state, prevention of obesity-related complications generates $42 billion in annual savings, yielding net savings of $11 billion per year and a return on investment of 2.7:1. Over ten years, the policy saves 100,000-120,000 lives while generating $21 billion in cumulative net savings to taxpayers. We propose a phased three-year implementation framework with medical necessity criteria (BMI ≥30 or BMI ≥27 with comorbidities), streamlined prior authorization, mandatory lifestyle program participation, and continuous quality monitoring. Current statutory exclusion of weight-loss medications dates from 2003, before obesity was medically recognized as a disease and when available drugs were dangerous and ineffective. This anachronistic policy creates a two-tiered healthcare system where privately insured patients increasingly access transformative treatment while 24 million Medicaid beneficiaries-disproportionately Black women (57% obesity prevalence), Hispanic adults (50% prevalence), and rural residents-are systematically denied care. This evidence-based policy framework addresses documented health disparities, provides equal access to transformative treatment, and strengthens both public health outcomes and fiscal sustainability of the Medicaid program. The time for policy modernization is now.

title: Integrated Landscapes, Systemic Change: An Agroecological Framework for Sub-Saharan Africa
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Integrated Landscapes, Systemic Change: An Agroecological Framework for Sub-Saharan Africa
detail.abstract: Sub-Saharan Africa’s food systems face a structural paradox: vast resource potential coexists with chronic food insecurity and declining soil fertility. Conventional intensification strategies have failed to overcome the region’s low fertilizer responsiveness and widespread soil organic carbon (SOC) depletion, which together sustain a low-productivity trap. This paper positions agroecology as a systemic framework for transformation, integrating biophysical restoration, institutional coordination, and market reform. Adapting transition theory, it proposes four interdependent pathways – Enhanced Nutrient Use Efficiency, SOC Recapitalization, Landscape Redesign, and Producer–Consumer Reconnection–that operate across nested social–ecological scales. The framework conceptualizes agroecological transition as the emergence of multifunctional landscapes in which production, conservation, and equity reinforce one another. Each pathway is empirically tractable, linking nutrient-use efficiency, soil-carbon dynamics, governance mechanisms, and territorial market structures. The paper situates this framework within continental policy processes such as the Africa Fertilizer and Soil Health Declaration, identifying fiscal, financial, and governance reforms needed to institutionalize soil health and ecosystem functionality as public goods. Together, these pathways offer a coherent model for systemic transformation of Africa’s food systems grounded in ecological integrity and social inclusion.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出以农业生态学作为系统性转型框架，通过四条相互依存的路径（养分利用效率提升、土壤有机碳重建、景观重新设计、生产者-消费者重新连接）来解决撒哈拉以南非洲粮食系统的结构性矛盾，实现生态完整性和社会包容性的系统性转型。

AI.theory_contributions: 将农业生态转型概念化为多功能景观的出现，为系统性粮食系统转型提供了理论框架；将转型理论与农业生态学相结合，丰富了转型理论的应用领域。

title: Money Demand in Micro-founded Model with Heterogeneity in Time Preference

detail.title: Money Demand in Micro-founded Model with Heterogeneity in Time Preference
detail.abstract: We develop a micro-founded monetary model à la Lagos and Wright (2005) to analyze the impact of heterogeneity in time preference on real allocations and money demand dynamics. The research indicates a shift in time preference, with agents being impatient before 2008 and patient afterward. Furthermore, model estimates show a decline in relative risk aversion α after 2008, a finding consistent with the increase in patience. For policymakers, these findings call for adapting the regulatory framework to facilitate long-term, higher risk-return investments while safeguarding financial stability.

title: Between Development and Climate Change: Exploring Key Aspects of Costa Rica's Climate Resilience Journey

detail.title: Between Development and Climate Change: Exploring Key Aspects of Costa Rica's Climate Resilience Journey

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no conflicts of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: This project did not involve human participants or identifiable personal data; therefore, ethics approval and written informed consent were not required

detail.abstract: This paper reviews Costa Rica's contemporary strategies for climate mitigation and adaptation, situating its progress within wider debates on global climate resilience. Climate change threatens lives, livelihoods, and ecosystems, with disproportionate impacts on countries in the Global South that must simultaneously pursue socioeconomic development. Despite these pressures, Costa Rica has become a global leader in environmental protection, sustainability, and nature rights, earning widespread recognition for ambitious and innovative climate governance. This review synthesizes core areas of Costa Rican climate action, including policy frameworks, conservation initiatives, renewable energy transitions, and climate-oriented investment strategies. These measures have produced one of the most climate-resilient national models in Latin America and the wider developing world. The analysis identifies transferable lessons and best-practice insights relevant to climate policy design, highlighting the need for expanded comparative research across diverse national contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了哥斯达黎加在气候减缓和适应方面的当代策略，将其进展置于全球气候韧性辩论的背景下。哥斯达黎加已成为环境保护、可持续性和自然权利的全球领导者，其气候治理措施包括政策框架、保护倡议、可再生能源转型和气候导向投资策略，为其他发展中国家提供了可转移的经验。
AI.research_question: 哥斯达黎加如何通过其气候治理策略成为拉丁美洲和发展中国家中最具气候韧性的国家模式？
AI.motivation: 气候变化威胁生命、生计和生态系统，对同时追求社会经济发展的全球南方国家造成不成比例的影响。尽管面临这些压力，哥斯达黎加在环境保护和气候治理方面取得了显著成就。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球气候韧性辩论、可持续发展理论、环境治理理论
AI.method: 文献综述和综合分析，梳理哥斯达黎加气候行动的核心领域
AI.findings: 哥斯达黎加的气候治理措施包括政策框架、保护倡议、可再生能源转型和气候导向投资策略，这些措施使其成为拉丁美洲和发展中国家中最具气候韧性的国家之一。
AI.theory_contributions: 为气候政策设计提供了可转移的经验和最佳实践见解，强调了在不同国家背景下进行扩展比较研究的必要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他发展中国家提供了哥斯达黎加在气候治理方面的成功经验，包括政策框架设计、可再生能源转型策略和气候导向投资模式。

title: Ethics of Automation and Artificial Intelligence in Health Care Delivery
affiliations: University of Florida - Department of Medicine, University of Oklahoma - College of Medicine, Medical College of Wisconsin, Federation of State Medical Boards and Johns Hopkins University - School of Medicine

detail.title: Ethics of Automation and Artificial Intelligence in Health Care Delivery

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Dr. D'Souza has nothing to declare. Mr. Spear has nothing to declare. Dr. Ehrenfeld reports prior service on the American Medical Association Board of Trustees. Dr. Chaudhry reports serving as the CEO of the Federation of State Medical Boards. Dr. Miller reports prior service as a Medical Officer at the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received in support of this paper.

detail.abstract: The healthcare industry, stagnant in productivity and overburdened by administrative tasks, stands to benefit greatly from artificial intelligence (AI) tools. Understandably, AI in healthcare has been met with skepticism and regulatory scrutiny, especially in the face of potential ethical issues. This paper examines the ethical implications of AI in healthcare as it applies to three primary use cases: automating administrative tasks, augmenting clinical practice, and automatic specific care elements. First, recent organizational actions will be examined and critiqued. Then, the four main principles of bioethics will be discussed using clinical case examples. These patient scenarios will highlight specific use cases for AI in healthcare, challenges for ethical implementation, and their potential solutions. To achieve a more efficient, effective, and convenient health care system that benefits both patients and clinicians, deployment of AI in healthcare must be contained within ethical guardrails which remain flexible to evolve with the technology. This applies to patient consent, transparency in AI algorithms to the end user, regulatory oversight, liability framework, and dataset standards. Care should be taken to avoid comparing AI tools to unrealistic standard of perfection, but rather to the current, imperfect standard of care.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了AI在医疗保健中的伦理影响，分析了三个主要应用场景：自动化行政任务、增强临床实践和自动特定护理元素。通过临床案例讨论了生物伦理学的四大原则，并提出了在患者同意、算法透明度、监管监督、责任框架和数据标准等方面的伦理护栏。
AI.research_question: AI在医疗保健中的伦理影响是什么？如何在三个主要应用场景（自动化行政任务、增强临床实践、自动特定护理元素）中实施伦理护栏？
AI.motivation: 医疗保健行业生产力停滞，行政任务负担过重，AI工具可带来巨大效益，但面临伦理问题和监管审查的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生物伦理学的四大原则（自主、不伤害、行善、公正），结合AI在医疗保健中的伦理框架。
AI.method: 分析近期组织行动，通过临床案例讨论生物伦理学原则，识别伦理挑战并提出解决方案。
AI.findings: AI在医疗保健中面临患者同意、算法透明度、监管监督、责任框架和数据标准等伦理挑战。需要建立灵活的伦理护栏，避免将AI工具与不切实际的完美标准比较。
AI.theory_contributions: 将生物伦理学原则应用于AI医疗场景，构建了包含患者同意、透明度、监管、责任和数据标准的伦理框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗AI部署提供了具体的伦理实施指南，帮助在提高效率的同时确保患者安全和伦理合规。

title: Data-Efficient Deep Learning for Differentiating Upper Trapezius Muscle with Myofascial Trigger Point on a Small Prospective sEMG Dataset
affiliations: University of Pittsburgh, University of Toronto, University of Pittsburgh, University of Pittsburgh, University of Pittsburgh, University of Pittsburgh, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Toronto - University Health Network and University of Pittsburgh

detail.title: Data-Efficient Deep Learning for Differentiating Upper Trapezius Muscle with Myofascial Trigger Point on a Small Prospective sEMG Dataset
detail.abstract: Deep learning has emerged as a transformative tool in biomedical research, yet its performance typically depends on large, well-annotated datasets. This poses a critical challenge for early-stage, hypothesis-driven studies, where data are often limited due to cost, recruitment constraints, or disease rarity. In this study, we investigated whether surface electromyography (sEMG) contains discriminative information to differentiate myofascial pain of upper trapezius muscle using deep learning on limited samples to establish the feasibility of a data-efficient deep learning strategy. sEMG signals of the upper trapezius were recorded from healthy controls (n=9) and MPS patients (n=13) during standardized motion tasks and an in-between stretching intervention. Signals were preprocessed, and contraction segments from pre-intervention (N=140) and post-intervention (N=139) tests were extracted using a proposed segmentation algorithm. A 1D convolution neural network (CNN) was trained on the contraction segments and evaluated with stratified five-fold cross-validation at subject level. Model performances were assessed on pre-, post-, and combined contraction samples separately using binary cross-entropy, pairwise logistic, and hybrid loss functions. Evaluation metrics include accuracy, F1-score, Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC), and the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC-AUC) with 95% confidence interval. Performance differences were compared using paired t-test on AUC. The 1D CNN with pairwise logistic loss achieved the best performance using pre-intervention segments, with an ROC-AUC of 0.835, F1-score of 0.840, accuracy of 0.793, and MCC of 0.604. These findings demonstrate that sEMG signals of the upper trapezius contain discriminative features for distinguishing myofascial pain from healthy controls. Despite the small dataset, the deep learning model achieved reasonable classification performance, demonstrating that carefully designed, data-efficient architectures can extract clinically meaningful signal patterns under limited-sample conditions.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了在有限样本条件下使用深度学习从表面肌电信号中区分肌筋膜疼痛的可行性，开发了一种数据高效的深度学习策略。
AI.research_question: 表面肌电信号是否包含能够区分上斜方肌肌筋膜疼痛的判别性信息？
AI.motivation: 深度学习在生物医学研究中具有变革性作用，但其性能通常依赖于大型、标注良好的数据集，而早期假设驱动研究往往因成本、招募限制或疾病罕见性而数据有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于深度学习的生物医学信号分析理论，特别是一维卷积神经网络在时间序列信号处理中的应用。
AI.method: 采集健康对照（n=9）和MPS患者（n=13）的上斜方肌sEMG信号，使用提出的分割算法提取收缩段，训练1D CNN模型，采用分层五折交叉验证评估性能。
AI.findings: 使用成对逻辑损失函数的1D CNN在干预前段上表现最佳，ROC-AUC为0.835，F1分数为0.840，准确率为0.793，MCC为0.604。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了在有限样本条件下，精心设计的数据高效架构能够提取具有临床意义的信号模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为早期假设驱动研究提供了一种可行的数据高效深度学习策略，可在小数据集条件下实现合理的分类性能。

title: Superstar Founders
affiliations: UCLA Anderson School of Management and School of Finance, Nankai University

detail.title: Superstar Founders
detail.abstract: Superstar founders-those who take a firm public through a true IPO-represent a substantial share of the extreme right tail of the US wealth distribution. This paper provides the first comprehensive analysis of their wealth accumulation, from the IPO through the firm's public lifecycle. Using hand-collected data on founder and venture capital ownership from 1996 to 2021, we document three key findings. First, we quantify a persistent trade-off: while VC backing enables firms to reach a larger scale at IPO, it is associated with a significant reduction in founder ownership and wealth. Second, we introduce a novel and comprehensive wealth measure that incorporates both the accumulated proceeds from post-IPO share liquidations and the gains from underpriced acquisitions. We show that relying solely on retained ownership understates founder wealth by 50% for firms ten years post-IPO. Additionally, founders' acquisition of new shares below market price contributes 5% to total wealth. Third, we demonstrate that path-dependent ownership dynamics, predictable from the initial IPO stake, explain 40% of the variation in founders' wealth growth rates. Ultimately, extreme wealth is achieved by founders who maintain substantial stakes in the selection of firms that persistently outperform the market and achieve massive scale over time. Our findings provide the microfoundations for the rise in top wealth shares, highlighting the IPO as a key entry channel and post-IPO ownership dynamics as critical amplifiers of founder fortunes.

AI.tldr: 本文首次全面分析超级明星创始人（通过IPO上市的企业创始人）的财富积累过程，发现VC支持虽能扩大企业规模但显著降低创始人持股比例，提出包含股票变现和低价收购收益的综合财富衡量方法，揭示初始IPO持股可预测40%的财富增长差异。
AI.research_question: 超级明星创始人如何通过IPO及后续公开市场生命周期积累财富？
AI.motivation: 超级明星创始人占据了美国财富分布极端右尾的相当大份额，但对其从IPO到企业公开生命周期财富积累过程缺乏系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财富积累理论、所有权动态理论、风险投资与创始人关系理论
AI.method: 使用1996-2021年手工收集的创始人和风险投资所有权数据进行分析
AI.findings: 1. VC支持存在规模与所有权的权衡；2. 仅依赖持股低估创始人财富50%；3. 初始IPO持股可解释40%的财富增长差异
AI.theory_contributions: 为顶级财富份额上升提供微观基础，强调IPO作为关键进入渠道和后续所有权动态作为财富放大器的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为创始人财富管理策略、风险投资决策和财富分配政策提供实证依据

title: The Effect of Master’s Level Social Worker Licensing Reform in Illinois
affiliations: Archbridge Institute, Illinois Policy Institute and Illinois Policy Institute

detail.title: The Effect of Master’s Level Social Worker Licensing Reform in Illinois
detail.abstract: Shortages of healthcare professionals, particularly in mental health, remain an ongoing policy dilemma. Licensing requirements may be one potential factor contributing to this shortage. In 2022, Illinois eliminated the exam requirement for master's level social workers (MSWs). Using data on the number of MSWs from several states, we estimate the effect of this policy change on the number of MSWs in Illinois using the synthetic control method. We estimate that the elimination of the exam requirement increased the number of MSWs in Illinois by more than 2,600 licensees-a 50% increase. We also provide evidence that our estimates are both economically and statistically significant.

AI.tldr: 伊利诺伊州取消硕士级社工考试要求后，MSW持证人数增加了2600多人，增幅达50%，表明考试要求是影响医疗专业人员供应的因素之一。
AI.research_question: 取消硕士级社工的考试要求对持证人数有何影响？
AI.motivation: 医疗专业人员短缺，特别是心理健康领域，是一个持续的政策困境。许可要求可能是导致这种短缺的潜在因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 许可要求作为医疗专业人员供应的障碍
AI.method: 使用多个州的MSW数据，采用合成控制法估计政策变化对伊利诺伊州MSW数量的影响
AI.findings: 取消考试要求使伊利诺伊州的MSW持证人数增加了2600多人，增幅达50%
AI.theory_contributions: 证实许可要求是影响医疗专业人员供应的显著因素
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了减少医疗专业人员短缺的具体措施证据

title: How Risk Preferences and Perceived Yield Distributions Affect Farmer Adaptation to Climate Change
affiliations: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign and Dept. of Agricultural, Food, and Resource Economics, Michigan State University

detail.title: How Risk Preferences and Perceived Yield Distributions Affect Farmer Adaptation to Climate Change
detail.abstract: Agricultural producers’ risk preferences and perceptions of climate change risks play a significant role in shaping their adaptation decisions. This research elicits farmers’ subjective probability distributions of crop yields, which are shaped in part by their risk preferences.  Both the mean and variance of the subjective yield distributions, along with risk preferences, drive farmers’ decisions on which water management technologies to adopt in order to adapt to changing weather risk. Based on detailed interviews, corn farmers in Michigan, USA, anticipate that in the absence of water management practices, both the mean and the variance of their corn yields will increase. They expect that adopting irrigation and, to a lesser degree, tile drainage will further increase mean yields. Adopting drought-resistant seed varieties, by contrast, will only slightly increase the mean while also reducing variance. More risk averse farmers perceive higher crop yield variances and are more likely to state that they plan to adopt irrigation technology in the future. We find that how farmers adapt to climate change is shaped by how they perceive the changing probability distribution of crop yields as well as by their risk attitudes. These findings suggest that policies and extension programs promoting climate adaptation technologies should emphasize not only potential changes to mean crop yield, but also their role in reducing yield risk, particularly for more risk averse farmers.

AI.tldr: 农民的风险偏好和对气候变化风险的认知显著影响其适应决策。研究发现密歇根州玉米种植者预期在没有水资源管理措施的情况下，玉米产量的均值和方差都会增加。灌溉和排水技术能提高平均产量，而抗旱种子品种主要降低产量方差。风险厌恶程度更高的农民感知到更高的产量方差，更可能计划采用灌溉技术。
AI.research_question: 农民的风险偏好和主观产量分布认知如何影响其水资源管理技术采用决策？
AI.motivation: 理解农民如何适应气候变化风险，特别是他们的风险偏好和产量风险认知如何影响适应技术采用决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于风险偏好理论和主观概率分布理论，分析农民对产量均值和方差的预期如何影响技术采用决策。
AI.method: 基于详细访谈，收集密歇根州玉米农民的主观产量分布数据，分析风险偏好与适应决策的关系。
AI.findings: 农民预期无管理措施时产量均值和方差增加；灌溉和排水提高均值；抗旱种子主要降低方差；风险厌恶农民更倾向采用灌溉技术。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了风险偏好理论在农业适应决策中的应用，强调主观产量分布认知在技术采用决策中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供指导：推广气候适应技术时应同时强调平均产量提升和风险降低，特别是针对风险厌恶农民。

title: Austerity and Intergenerational Mobility: Evidence from Greece's Bailout Era *
affiliations: De Montfort University - Faculty of Business and Law and De Montfort University - Faculty of Business and Law

detail.title: Austerity and Intergenerational Mobility: Evidence from Greece's Bailout Era *

declarations.ethicsApproval: The research is approved by De Montfort University Ethical committee.

detail.abstract: Using data from the European Union Statistics on Income and Living Conditions (EU-SILC, 2011-2019), this paper examines the impact of Greece's economic adjustment programs-implemented through successive bailout agreements between 2010 and 2018-on intergenerational mobility. To address concerns related to co-residence selection, we incorporate information from the European Community Household Panel and estimate a two-sample two-stage least squares (TS2SLS) model. The empirical results indicate a substantial increase in intergenerational income elasticity toward the end of the bailout period, implying a decline in income mobility. This finding is robust to a wide range of checks, including alternative measures of income and mobility, the use of disaggregated income definitions and the presence of zero income. We further investigate potential mechanisms and provide evidence on the key channels through which the bailout programs contributed to reduced mobility. Overall, the analysis offers new insights into the evolution of income mobility in Greece during its post-crisis adjustment.

AI.tldr: 本文使用欧盟收入与生活条件统计数据，研究发现希腊的经济调整计划显著增加了代际收入弹性，意味着收入流动性下降，并通过多种稳健性检验证实了这一发现。
AI.research_question: 希腊的经济调整计划（2010-2018年救助协议）对代际流动性的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究希腊经济危机期间实施的救助计划如何影响代际收入流动性，填补了危机后调整时期收入流动性演变的研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际流动性理论、经济调整计划影响机制理论
AI.method: 使用欧盟收入与生活条件统计数据（2011-2019年），结合欧洲社区家庭面板信息，采用两样本两阶段最小二乘法模型，解决共同居住选择问题。
AI.findings: 救助计划末期代际收入弹性显著增加，表明收入流动性下降，这一结果在多种稳健性检验中均成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 为经济危机期间救助计划对代际流动性影响提供了新的理论见解和实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于经济调整计划对收入分配和代际流动影响的重要参考，有助于评估救助政策的社会后果。

title: Bayesian Persuasion without Commitment
affiliations: and University of Toronto

detail.title: Bayesian Persuasion without Commitment
detail.abstract: We introduce a model of persuasion in which a sender without any commitment power privately gathers information about an unknown state of the world and then chooses what to verifiably disclose to a receiver. The receiver does not know how many experiments the sender is able to run, and may therefore be uncertain as to whether the sender disclosed all of her information. Despite this challenge, we show that, under general conditions, the sender is able to achieve the same payoff as in the full-commitment Bayesian persuasion case.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了无承诺能力的发送者如何通过选择性披露信息来说服接收者，即使接收者不知道发送者进行了多少实验，发送者仍能达到与完全承诺贝叶斯说服相同的收益。
AI.research_question: 在发送者没有承诺能力且接收者不知道发送者信息收集程度的情况下，发送者能否实现与完全承诺贝叶斯说服相同的说服效果？
AI.motivation: 现实世界中，信息发送者往往无法承诺完全披露所有收集到的信息，而接收者也无法确知发送者实际掌握的信息量，这为说服理论带来了新的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于贝叶斯说服理论框架，扩展了无承诺能力情况下的信息选择性披露模型。
AI.method: 构建理论模型，分析发送者私下收集信息后选择性披露的策略，以及接收者对发送者信息收集程度不确定性的反应。
AI.findings: 在一般条件下，即使接收者不知道发送者进行了多少实验，发送者仍能实现与完全承诺贝叶斯说服相同的收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了贝叶斯说服理论，证明了在无承诺能力和接收者信息不对称的情况下，发送者仍能达到最优说服效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为现实世界中信息不对称情况下的说服策略提供了理论指导，特别是在无法完全承诺信息披露的场景中。

title: American Bar Association Resolution 507 (2025) and Associated Report
affiliations: Temple University - James E. Beasley School of Law, Pace University - School of Law, University of Pittsburgh - School of Law, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Schnader Harrison Segal & Lewis

detail.title: American Bar Association Resolution 507 (2025) and Associated Report
detail.abstract:
This Resolution, adopted by the American Bar Association in August 2025, along with the accompanying Report urges the repeal of all taxes on menstrual products at every level of government and supports federal and international efforts to eliminate such taxation. 

The ABA’s Resolution 507 marks the first official stance by the nation’s largest professional association of lawyers on what is commonly known as the “tampon tax.” Grounded in principles of gender equity, tax fairness, and dignity, the accompanying Report makes the case that menstrual products are essential healthcare items and should not be taxed as luxury goods. The Report highlights the disparate impact of sales tax regimes on people who menstruate, particularly those already burdened by poverty and marginalization. Drawing on constitutional arguments, tax policy scholarship, and international comparisons, the Report situates menstrual equity as a legal and human rights issue. 

By recognizing tax policy as a vehicle for justice, the ABA affirms the responsibility of the legal profession to challenge structural inequities embedded in seemingly neutral laws. Resolution 507 provides a blueprint for lawyers, lawmakers, and advocates to advance tax justice as part of the broader movement for menstrual equity.

The Resolution was co-sponsored by (and benefited from the input of) the Section of Taxation, Section of State and Local Government Law, Section of Civil Rights and Social Justice, Section of International Law, Commission on Women in the Profession, Commission on Homelessness and Poverty, the Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Center, and the Law Student Division. This Resolution and Report should be read in conjunction with the framing essay by Bridget J. Crawford, How the ABA Resolved to End the Tampon Tax, forthcoming in The Tax Lawyer (2026).

AI.tldr: 美国律师协会通过507号决议，呼吁各级政府废除对月经产品的征税，支持联邦和国际层面消除此类税收，认为月经产品是基本医疗用品而非奢侈品。
AI.research_question: 如何通过法律和政策手段消除月经产品税收，实现性别平等和税收公平？
AI.motivation: 月经产品税对经期人群，特别是贫困和边缘化群体造成不成比例的影响，违背性别平等和税收公平原则。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于性别平等、税收公平和尊严原则，结合宪法论证、税收政策学术研究和国际比较。
AI.method: 通过法律决议、政策分析和国际比较的方法，提出废除月经产品税的法律依据和政策建议。
AI.findings: 月经产品是基本医疗必需品，对其征税构成性别歧视，对经期人群造成经济负担。
AI.theory_contributions: 将月经公平确立为法律和人权问题，扩展了税收公平理论在性别平等领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为律师、立法者和倡导者提供了推进税收正义的具体蓝图，推动各级政府的政策改革。

title: "More Work, Less Time for What We Will?" The Trade-Offs between Work and Non-Work Time in the US, 2003-2024, and their Implications for Worker Well-Being
affiliations: and Pennsylvania State University - Abington College

detail.title: "More Work, Less Time for What We Will?" The Trade-Offs between Work and Non-Work Time in the US, 2003-2024, and their Implications for Worker Well-Being
detail.abstract: This article explores the association between the length of individuals' daily working time in the US and the amount of time they allocate toward non-work activities. To illustrate the trade-offs incurred by longer work hours, we use the Current Population Survey's American Time Use Survey, 2003-2024. We divide unpaid non-work time into leisure, household production, caregiving, volunteering, education, and sleep time. We find that each additional hour of work time is associated with a reduction of 15 minutes of housework, 5 minutes of caregiving, and 21 minutes of leisure. In addition to demonstrating differences in individuals' allocation of non-work time based on gender and household composition, we forward the current literature by revealing differences in time use based on race, education, and post-covid effects, raising questions for future research. We conclude by exploring the implications of these time allocation patterns and constraints for worker well-being and potential policy reforms.

AI.tldr: 本文使用美国时间使用调查数据（2003-2024），研究发现每增加1小时工作时间，家务时间减少15分钟，照料时间减少5分钟，休闲时间减少21分钟。研究还揭示了基于性别、家庭构成、种族、教育和疫情后效应的非工作时间分配差异。
AI.research_question: 美国个体每日工作时间长度与非工作时间分配之间的关联是什么？
AI.motivation: 探讨更长工作时间所带来的权衡取舍，了解工作与非工作时间分配的模式和约束对劳动者福祉的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间分配理论，工作-生活平衡理论
AI.method: 使用当前人口调查的美国时间使用调查数据（2003-2024年），将无薪非工作时间分为休闲、家务生产、照料、志愿服务、教育和睡眠时间
AI.findings: 每增加1小时工作时间，家务时间减少15分钟，照料时间减少5分钟，休闲时间减少21分钟；存在基于性别、家庭构成、种族、教育和疫情后效应的非工作时间分配差异
AI.theory_contributions: 推进了当前文献，揭示了基于种族、教育和疫情后效应的时间使用差异，为未来研究提出新问题
AI.practical_contributions: 探讨这些时间分配模式和约束对劳动者福祉的影响，为潜在政策改革提供依据

title: After the U.S. Dollar Collapse: Rebuilding America's Financial System with a Multi-Metal Monetary System
affiliations: Faculty of Business Administration and Accountancy, Khon Kaen University

detail.title: After the U.S. Dollar Collapse: Rebuilding America's Financial System with a Multi-Metal Monetary System
detail.abstract: This study proposes a theoretical framework for reconstructing the U.S. monetary and financial system after a dollar collapse/reset. It outlines a three-tier model grounded in tangible assets with a regulatory, transparent oversight. Tier 1 establishes the U.S. Mint as the monetary base that issues a digital currency backed by a portfolio of metals. The nominal money supply target is maintained by daily, dynamically changing ratios that automatically respond to market conditions. Tier 2 comprises the U.S. Treasury, the Federal Reserve, and the banking system, which provide fiscal stability and credit intermediation without money creation. Tier 3 comprises the businesses, governments, and households. They interact through a digital ecosystem that promotes trust, inclusion, and transparency. The novel design integrates historical lessons from commodity-backed systems, modern digital finance, and the gold standard. A one-time debt jubilee transfers wealth to households, families, and small businesses, restoring solvency and narrowing the wealth gap between the haves and have-nots. The wealth transfer helps jump-start the consumer economy and rev up the nation's economic engine. The proposed system transforms money into an efficient medium of exchange and a stable store of value.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个三层理论框架，用于在美元崩溃/重置后重建美国货币金融体系。该模型以有形资产为基础，包含监管透明的监督机制，包括金属支持的央行数字货币、无货币创造的金融中介，以及促进信任的数字生态系统。
AI.research_question: 如何在美元崩溃/重置后重建一个稳定、透明的美国货币金融体系？
AI.motivation: 应对美元可能崩溃的风险，建立一个基于有形资产、监管透明的新货币体系，解决当前系统的脆弱性和财富不平等问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三层理论框架：第一层为金属支持的央行数字货币，第二层为无货币创造的金融中介，第三层为数字生态系统。整合了商品本位制、现代数字金融和金本位制的历史经验。
AI.method: 理论框架构建方法，基于历史经验教训和现代金融技术设计三层模型。
AI.findings: 提出的三层模型能够将货币转化为高效的交换媒介和稳定的价值储存手段，通过一次性债务豁免缩小贫富差距，重启消费经济。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合历史经验和现代技术的货币金融体系重建理论框架，为后美元时代的货币体系设计提供了新思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的体系重建方案，包括债务豁免、财富再分配等实际措施，有助于经济稳定和社会公平。

title: China's Approach to International AI Governance: Selective Shaping?
affiliations: Singapore Management University - Yong Pung How School of Law

detail.title: China's Approach to International AI Governance: Selective Shaping?
detail.abstract:
China is rapidly solidifying its position as a key actor in the development and governance of artificial intelligence (AI). Domestically, China is exploring a comprehensive and evolving regulatory framework. Internationally, China has transitioned from a passive recipient of external norms to a proactive norm-shaper, advancing its vision of AI governance through initiatives such as the Global AI Governance Initiative. This contrasts with its earlier accession to the World Trade Organization, when it adapted to pre-existing rules. As a leading AI power, China now influences governance practice at the international level.​

    This paper explores two important but underexplored questions: What is China’s approach to international AI governance? How to understand China’s approach? This paper argues that China pursues a strategy of selective shaping in international AI governance, resulting in a targeted reshaping of global order. By “uploading” China-proposed institutions and norms particularly in areas of strength, China leverages new initiatives and standards to shape the developing landscape of AI governance. Meanwhile, China’s approach also faces challenges such as normative ambiguity.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨中国在国际人工智能治理中的选择性塑造策略，分析中国如何通过提出制度和规范来重塑全球AI治理格局，同时面临规范性模糊等挑战。
AI.research_question: 中国在国际人工智能治理中的方法是什么？如何理解中国的这种方法？
AI.motivation: 中国正从外部规范的被动接受者转变为主动的规范塑造者，在国际AI治理中发挥日益重要的作用，但其具体方法和策略尚未得到充分探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 选择性塑造策略、规范上传理论、全球秩序重塑
AI.method: 未在摘要中明确说明，但基于对政策文件和国际倡议的分析
AI.findings: 中国在国际AI治理中采取选择性塑造策略，通过在优势领域上传中国提出的制度和规范来有针对性地重塑全球秩序，但面临规范性模糊等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了选择性塑造策略的概念框架，深化了对新兴大国在全球治理中角色转变的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国和其他新兴大国在国际技术治理中的策略制定提供参考，有助于理解全球AI治理格局的演变。

title: Digital Distance: The Shift from In-Person to Remote Socializing in India
affiliations: Apna.Co and Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad

detail.title: Digital Distance: The Shift from In-Person to Remote Socializing in India
detail.abstract: Using a 10% random sample of India's 2024 Time Use Survey, we document a substantial disparity in social interaction patterns: remote socializing (phone calls, messaging, digital communication) is approximately 40 times more prevalent than formal in-person community participation in time-use diaries. Daily participation in remote social activities stands at 1.55% (95% CI: 1.48-1.62%), while in-person community activities register at 0.04% (95% CI: 0.03-0.05%). This paper investigates demographic correlates of this pattern. We find that marriage is positively associated with remote socializing and negatively associated with in-person community participation, with these associations present for both men and women. Urban residence and higher education are also positively associated with remote social engagement. These findings document how India's social interaction patterns reflect both traditional social institutions (marriage, gender norms) and modern factors (urbanization, education, digital infrastructure). The patterns we identify have important implications for understanding contemporary social networks, though causal mechanisms require further investigation with longitudinal data. Our results contribute to understanding digital * Apna.co 1 transformation in a major developing economy where traditional community structures coexist with rapid technological adoption.

AI.tldr: 基于印度2024年时间使用调查10%随机样本，研究发现远程社交活动参与率（1.55%）是正式线下社区活动（0.04%）的约40倍。婚姻状况、城市居住和教育水平是远程社交的重要相关因素。
AI.research_question: 印度社会互动模式的人口统计学相关因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 记录印度社会互动模式中远程社交与线下社区参与的显著差异，并探究其人口统计学相关性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 传统社会制度（婚姻、性别规范）与现代因素（城市化、教育、数字基础设施）共同影响社会互动模式的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用印度2024年时间使用调查10%随机样本的时间使用日记数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 远程社交参与率（1.55%）远高于线下社区活动（0.04%）；婚姻与远程社交正相关、与线下社区参与负相关；城市居住和高等教育与远程社交正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了传统社会制度与现代因素如何共同塑造发展中国家的社会互动模式，为理解数字转型提供理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解当代社会网络提供重要启示，对政策制定者在数字基础设施和社会服务规划方面具有实践价值。

title: Baskets Full of Cash: Primary Market Frictions and the Performance of Active Bond ETFs
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Finance, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - CUHK Business School, Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Finance and Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST)

detail.title: Baskets Full of Cash: Primary Market Frictions and the Performance of Active Bond ETFs
detail.abstract: We find that active corporate bond ETFs earn lower net-of-fee alpha than comparable mutual funds, particularly among high-yield funds and even when comparing same-manager funds. We trace this performance gap to a friction inherent in the ETF structure: misaligned incentives between active managers and authorized participants (APs). Bonds received in kind from APs reflect dealer inventory pressures and subsequently earn lower long-horizon returns than bonds purchased directly by the same ETFs. Knowing this, active ETFs—unlike passive ETFs—rely predominantly on cash to settle creation and redemption, and trade directly in the bond market, much like mutual funds. We investigate the determinants of cash settlement and build a model that rationalizes the performance gap despite managers’ flexibility to use cash. Overall, these results suggest that the ETF structure introduces frictions to active bond funds, to which managers respond by using cash settlement as a partial remedy.

AI.tldr: 主动型公司债券ETF的净费后alpha收益低于可比共同基金，主要原因是ETF结构中授权参与者的激励错配导致债券接收质量较差，管理者通过现金结算作为部分补救措施。
AI.research_question: 主动型公司债券ETF为何表现不如可比共同基金？
AI.motivation: 理解ETF结构对主动型债券基金表现的潜在负面影响，揭示ETF结构中存在的摩擦机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: ETF结构中的激励错配理论、授权参与者与基金管理者的利益冲突、现金结算与实物结算的效率差异。
AI.method: 比较主动型公司债券ETF与共同基金的表现差异，分析债券接收来源与长期回报的关系，研究现金结算的决定因素。
AI.findings: 1. 主动型债券ETF表现差于共同基金，特别是高收益基金；2. APs提供的债券反映经销商库存压力，长期回报较低；3. 主动型ETF主要依赖现金结算；4. 现金结算作为部分补救措施。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了ETF结构中激励错配对主动管理的影响机制，发展了ETF结构摩擦理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者选择债券基金提供指导，为基金管理者优化ETF运营策略提供参考，促进ETF结构改进。

title: Structured Sentencing Algorithm for Ukraine
affiliations: National University "Odesa Law Academy"

detail.title: Structured Sentencing Algorithm for Ukraine

declarations.ethicsApproval: Disclaimer Text-generation software (AI Grok 5, ChatGPT 5, Perplexity, Grammarly) was used solely for editorial editing and style correction. All factual data have been personally verified and confirmed by the author. Responsibility for the content and accuracy of the legal analysis and recommendations rests entirely with the author

detail.abstract: This article presents the development of a structured sentencing algorithm for Ukraine that seeks to reconcile national principles of individualization with European standards of proportionality, while incorporating the autonomous interpretation of Article 7 of the European Convention on Human Rights (ECHR). It identifies the limitations of applying a general sentencing formula to specialized liability regimes, including martial law, corruption offenses, traffic offenses under intoxication, military offenses, domestic violence, genocide, and crimes against humanity. A refined sentencing formula is proposed, incorporating corrective mechanisms and exceptions, informed by the conceptual principles of the Draft New Criminal Code of Ukraine. The article also emphasizes the importance of judicial reasoning, transparency, and predictability while safeguarding proportionality in high-risk legal contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文为乌克兰开发了一个结构化的量刑算法，旨在协调国家个性化原则与欧洲比例标准，同时纳入对《欧洲人权公约》第7条的自主解释。该算法针对特殊责任制度提出了改进的量刑公式，强调司法推理、透明度和可预测性。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个结构化的量刑算法来协调乌克兰的个性化原则与欧洲的比例标准，同时应对特殊责任制度的挑战？
AI.motivation: 现有的一般量刑公式在应用于特殊责任制度时存在局限性，需要开发更精细的量刑方法以确保司法公正和比例原则。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧洲人权公约第7条、比例原则、个性化量刑原则、乌克兰新刑法典草案的概念原则
AI.method: 开发结构化的量刑算法，包含纠正机制和例外情况，基于乌克兰新刑法典草案的概念原则
AI.findings: 提出了一个改进的量刑公式，能够更好地处理特殊责任制度下的量刑问题，包括戒严法、腐败犯罪、酒驾、军事犯罪等
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了结合国家个性化原则与欧洲比例标准的量刑理论框架，为特殊责任制度提供了理论支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为乌克兰司法系统提供了实用的量刑工具，增强了司法推理的透明度、可预测性和比例原则的保障

title: Who Gets the Callback? Generative Artificial Intelligence and Gender Bias
affiliations: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi and Argonne National Laboratory

detail.title: Who Gets the Callback? Generative Artificial Intelligence and Gender Bias
detail.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) become integrated into hiring workflows, they are actively shaping which candidates get shortlisted for jobs. While they promise efficiency and scalability, growing concerns have emerged about their potential to reinforce societal biases. Yet, how such biases manifest in modern LLMs across a wide range of occupations in realistic hiring scenarios remains unclear. Moreover, behavioural alignment of models through human feedback, aimed at improving helpfulness, may inadvertently shape model personality in ways that affect bias, but this relationship is poorly understood. Here, we present a large-scale audit of gender bias in LLM-based recruitment, using 332,044 real-world job descriptions together with simulated recruiter personas. We show that LLMs disproportionately favour men, particularly for higher-wage roles, and systematically associate specific skills, traits, and occupations with gender. A comprehensive linguistic analysis reveals that model recommendations closely mirror traditional gender stereotypes. Crucially, assigning a low-agreeableness persona reduces bias, suggesting that sycophancy plays a key role in reinforcing stereotypes. Moreover, controversial personas trigger internal model guardrails, leading to more cautious and less biased outputs. Our results highlight how AI-driven hiring may perpetuate existing labour market inequalities and have implications for fairness and diversity.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过大规模审计发现，在基于大语言模型的招聘中，LLMs存在明显的性别偏见，特别是在高薪职位中更青睐男性候选人，并系统性地将特定技能、特质和职业与性别刻板印象关联。研究发现低宜人性人格可以减少偏见，而争议性人格会触发模型防护机制产生更谨慎的输出。
AI.research_question: 大语言模型在招聘过程中如何表现性别偏见？人类反馈对齐如何影响模型偏见？
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型被整合到招聘流程中，它们正在积极塑造哪些候选人能够入围。虽然它们承诺效率和可扩展性，但人们越来越担心它们可能强化社会偏见。然而，在现代LLMs中，这种偏见如何在现实招聘场景中广泛职业范围内表现仍不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会偏见理论、刻板印象理论和AI对齐理论，研究探讨LLMs如何反映和强化社会中的性别刻板印象。
AI.method: 使用332,044个真实世界职位描述和模拟招聘者人格进行大规模审计，结合全面的语言分析。
AI.findings: LLMs不成比例地青睐男性，特别是在高薪职位中，并系统性地将特定技能、特质和职业与性别关联。模型推荐密切反映传统性别刻板印象。低宜人性人格减少偏见，争议性人格触发防护机制导致更谨慎输出。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了人类反馈对齐对模型偏见的影响机制，特别是奉承行为在强化刻板印象中的关键作用，以及模型防护机制对偏见缓解的效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI驱动招聘的公平性和多样性提供重要启示，帮助开发更公平的招聘系统，减少劳动力市场不平等。

title: Who Owns Crypto in the Euro Area? Drivers of Crypto Adoption, Payment Use, and Its Interaction with Fiat Cash
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Who Owns Crypto in the Euro Area? Drivers of Crypto Adoption, Payment Use, and Its Interaction with Fiat Cash
detail.abstract: Using a survey of 39,507 adults in 17 euro-area countries, I find that crypto-asset owners and the niche subgroup of payers have distinct profiles. Owners –⁠ typically younger, male, urban, and financially active –⁠ exhibit mixed payment preferences, valuing both cash-like privacy and card-like speed. In contrast, the small subset of crypto payers displays a strictly cash-centric profile, seeking to replicate features of physical cash-such as privacy and ease of use-in a digital form. Regarding the interaction with fiat currency, standard specifications show that holding cash reserves is positively associated with owning crypto, suggesting portfolio complementarity in normal times and challenging the view that early adopters reject cash. However, a multiple-instrument IV strategy exploiting pandemic-related payment shocks reveals a causal sign reversal: for compliers, adopting a precautionary cash buffer reduces the probability of crypto ownership when uncertainty rises. These findings (1) explain the wedge between high ownership and negligible payment usage (confined to a small portion of transactions of ∼1.4% of consumers), (2) suggest that crypto and cash function as portfolio complements in normal times but as substitutes under stress, consistent with a flight-to-safety dynamic, and (3) inform debates on financial regulation, public-private currency competition, CBDC design, and the persistent use of physical currency.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过对欧元区17个国家39,507名成年人的调查，发现加密货币持有者与支付使用者具有不同特征。加密货币持有者通常年轻、男性、城市居民且金融活跃，支付偏好混合；而加密货币支付者则呈现严格的现金中心特征。研究发现加密货币与现金在正常时期是投资组合互补品，但在压力时期成为替代品。
AI.research_question: 加密货币持有者和支付使用者的特征差异是什么？加密货币与法定货币（特别是现金）之间的关系如何？
AI.motivation: 理解加密货币采用者的特征，以及加密货币与法定货币在正常时期和压力时期的互动关系，为金融监管、CBDC设计和公共-私人货币竞争提供见解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资组合理论、货币替代理论、预防性现金需求理论、金融创新采用理论
AI.method: 使用欧元区17个国家39,507名成年人的调查数据，采用标准回归分析和多工具变量IV策略（利用疫情相关的支付冲击）
AI.findings: 1) 加密货币持有者与支付使用者特征不同；2) 正常时期加密货币与现金是投资组合互补品；3) 压力时期加密货币与现金成为替代品；4) 加密货币支付使用率极低（仅约1.4%的消费者）
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 解释了高持有率与低支付使用率之间的差距；2) 揭示了加密货币与现金在不同情境下的互补/替代关系；3) 支持了避险动态理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融监管政策、CBDC设计、公共-私人货币竞争以及实物货币持续使用的讨论提供实证依据

title: Agrarian Distress in India and its Relation to Global Economic Systems
affiliations: Oberoi International School (OGC)

detail.title: Agrarian Distress in India and its Relation to Global Economic Systems

declarations.ethicsApproval: Interviews were taken from primary sources. Verbal (recorded) consent was taken from participants before all three interviews were conducted.

detail.abstract:
India’s agrarian sector, which sustains nearly half the nation’s workforce, is in a state of profound crisis, marked by stagnating incomes, rampant indebtedness, and tragic rates of farmer suicides. Conventional economic diagnostics, however, consistently misapprehend the nature of this distress. This research paper argues that the prevailing Indian agrarian crisis is a direct consequence of the systemic shortcomings embedded in the one-size-fits-all economic models that are propagated and enforced by global institutions like the IMF and WTO. These models, which advocate for rapid liberalization, market-driven reforms, and a transition away from agricultural (rural) employment, are fundamentally ill-suited for an economy where agriculture functions as more than merely an economic activity. For India, agriculture is a critical social safety net and a cultural cornerstone. It’s the backbone of the nation’s economy: agriculture, with its allied sectors, is the largest source of livelihoods in India.


Moving beyond a superficial recap of the farmer protests, this paper employs a mixed-methods approach. It integrates macroeconomic data analysis with qualitative insights from primary-source interviews with key stakeholders, including Supreme Court Committee member Devinder Sharma and prominent farmer-leader Tejveer Singh. The analysis reveals a disconnect between theory and practice, and demonstrates how policies designed to encourage corporate entry and state withdrawal have instead heightened farmer precarity. This is further evidenced by various patterns of distress, such as the alarming rate of farmer suicides (which serve as a stark reminder of systemic failure). Figures from 2022 indicate that at least one farmer died by suicide every hour in India. Furthermore, statistical analysis of cost-price squeezes, stagnant household incomes, and volatile export performance illustrates how integration into global markets has subjected smallholders to heightened financial vulnerability without proportionate, or frankly, any measurable gains.


The paper culminates by presenting a critique of universal economic templates. It contends that the failure of these models lies in their inability to account for India’s unique socioeconomic background, where the prescribed path of development is structurally impossible. By contrasting the failed national policy paradigm with a context-sensitive, welfare-oriented alternative model exemplified by Kerala, this research makes a case for an indigenous economic framework. Such a framework must prioritize legal guarantees for minimum support prices, robust social security mechanisms, and strategic global integration (unlike the current wholesale path). Ultimately, this study aims to challenge the hegemony of decontextualized economic systems and advocate for development models that are both theoretically sound and ethically grounded in the specificities of places and people.

AI.tldr: 本文认为印度农业危机源于IMF和WTO推广的通用经济模式不适用印度国情，这些模式忽视了农业作为社会安全网和文化基石的重要性。通过混合研究方法，论文揭示了政策理论与实践脱节，导致农民脆弱性加剧。最后提出基于喀拉拉邦经验的本土化经济框架建议。
AI.research_question: 为什么全球机构推广的通用经济模式在印度农业部门失败？这些模式如何加剧了印度农业危机？
AI.motivation: 印度农业部门支撑着近半数劳动力，但面临收入停滞、债务缠身和农民自杀率高等严重危机，而传统经济诊断持续误解这种困境的本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判通用经济模板理论，强调经济发展模式需要因地制宜，反对一刀切的经济自由化和市场化改革。
AI.method: 混合研究方法：整合宏观经济数据分析与对关键利益相关者（如最高法院委员会成员和农民领袖）的定性访谈。
AI.findings: 政策理论与实践脱节；鼓励企业进入和国家退出的政策加剧了农民脆弱性；全球市场整合使小农面临更高财务风险而无相应收益；2022年印度每小时至少一名农民自杀。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战去情境化经济体系的霸权，主张发展模式应基于地方特殊性；提出需要本土化经济框架的理论观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体政策建议：法律保障最低支持价格、健全社会保障机制、战略性全球整合；以喀拉拉邦为例展示福利导向替代模式的成功经验。

title: How Much Should CEOs, Doctors, and Unskilled Workers Make? An International Desire for Limited Inequality
affiliations: Yeshiva University

detail.title: How Much Should CEOs, Doctors, and Unskilled Workers Make? An International Desire for Limited Inequality

declarations.ethicsApproval: Data are from the International Social Survey Program, and participants could refuse to participate.

detail.abstract: What do people from different countries and social classes believe skilled and unskilled workers earn, and how does that compare to preferences about what those workers should earn? Nationally representative survey data from 29 countries were used to examine participants’ (N = 44,890) judgments of what chief executive officers (CEOs), general practice (GP) doctors and unskilled workers earn annually and, ideally, how much those different workers should earn. There was universal agreement that CEOs make too much compared to workers (a pay ratio of 9.09:1) than they ideally should (a ratio of 4.29:1). By contrast doctors were seen as making only slightly too much relative to workers (an estimated ratio of 3.5:1 vs. an ideal ratio of 3.0), and doctor vs. worker differences were not found in all countries. Direct pay estimates (rather than ratios) revealed that unskilled workers were universally seen as earning less than they should, CEOs as making too much, and doctors earning about what they should. Social class differences mostly involved perceptions of CEO pay. Overall, participants exhibited a desire for a limited range of income inequality – neither too high nor too low – and differentiated preferences regarding the pay for various categories of workers.

AI.tldr: 该研究调查了29个国家44,890名参与者对CEO、医生和非技术工人实际收入与理想收入的认知差异。研究发现人们普遍认为CEO收入过高，医生收入略高，非技术工人收入过低，且期望的收入不平等程度有限。
AI.research_question: 不同国家和社会阶层的人们如何认知技术工人和非技术工人的实际收入与理想收入？
AI.motivation: 了解人们对收入不平等的认知和偏好，以及这些认知如何影响对收入分配的公平性判断。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于收入不平等认知理论和社会公平理论，探讨人们对不同职业收入的实际认知与理想偏好。
AI.method: 使用29个国家的全国代表性调查数据，收集44,890名参与者对CEO、医生和非技术工人年收入的估计值和理想值。
AI.findings: 普遍认为CEO收入过高（实际比例9.09:1 vs 理想比例4.29:1），医生收入略高（3.5:1 vs 3.0），非技术工人收入过低；社会阶层差异主要体现在对CEO收入的认知上。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了人们对收入不平等存在有限范围的偏好，既不要过高也不要过低，且对不同职业类别的收入偏好存在差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于公众对收入分配偏好的实证依据，有助于设计更符合社会期望的收入分配政策。

title: The Mc Kenna Options and British Financial Policy in the War of 1914 – 1918
affiliations: National Institute of Economic and Social Research

detail.title: The Mc Kenna Options and British Financial Policy in the War of 1914 – 1918
detail.abstract: When the British government issued a second War Loan in June 1915, the Chancellor of the Exchequer Reginald McKenna offered generous conversion options to holders of the first War Loan that had been issued the previous November, and to holders of Consols and some other government securities. He also promised that holders of the second War Loan would have free options to convert into any future War Loan. The Mc Kenna options were extensively exercised by investors, at a heavy cost to the government, and historians have criticised them as a needless waste of money. This paper argues that the criticisms are misplaced and that the options served two necessary purposes. First, the options to War Loan holders overcame the problems of price discovery in the bond market, which were caused by the uncertainties created by the war, and thereby enabled heavy government borrowing to be funded. Second, the options to holders of Consols alleviated the commercial banks' losses on government securities, which would otherwise have threatened financial stability.

AI.tldr: 本文为1915年英国第二次战争贷款中的McKenna期权辩护，认为这些期权并非历史学家批评的浪费资金，而是具有两个必要目的：解决战争不确定性导致的债券市场价格发现问题，以及缓解商业银行在政府证券上的损失以维护金融稳定。
AI.research_question: 1915年英国第二次战争贷款中的McKenna期权是否如历史学家所批评的那样是浪费资金？
AI.motivation: 历史学家普遍批评McKenna期权给政府带来了沉重成本，是毫无必要的资金浪费，但本文认为这些批评存在误解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政府债券市场运作理论、金融稳定理论和战时财政政策理论。
AI.method: 历史分析和文献研究，考察1915年英国战争贷款的发行背景、期权条款及其实际效果。
AI.findings: McKenna期权实际上服务于两个必要目的：1) 克服战争不确定性导致的债券市场价格发现问题，使政府能够进行大规模借款；2) 缓解商业银行在政府证券上的损失，维护金融稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新评估战时财政政策工具的有效性，为政府债券期权在危机时期的作用提供理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为现代政府在危机时期制定财政政策提供历史经验，说明某些看似成本高昂的政策工具可能具有重要的稳定功能。

title: Introducing Biosocial Psychoanalysis: A Unified Theory of Sexual Serial Homicide

detail.title: Introducing Biosocial Psychoanalysis: A Unified Theory of Sexual Serial Homicide
detail.abstract: This paper presents an integrative biopsychosocial psychoanalytic theory of sexual serial homicide that unifies biological, developmental, and psychodynamic research into a coherent explanatory model. Drawing on Freudian metapsychology and contemporary findings from neuroscience, attachment theory, trauma studies, and criminology, the framework explains sexual serial murder as the cumulative outcome of interacting vulnerabilities across the lifespan. Biological and neurodevelopmental factors-including genetic predispositions, endocrine anomalies, and traumatic brain injury-shape impulse control, affect regulation, and reward circuitry, creating a foundation for later risk. Developmental and relational disruptions such as insecure attachment, father absence, maternal enmeshment, humiliation, sexual precocity, and chronic trauma further compromise mentalization, internal object stability, and narcissistic integrity.
